name: ichiran-node
description: Self-contained Ichiran Japanese analyzer for browsers and Node.js

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/node build && bun run --cwd packages/cli build && bun run --cwd packages/api build
scripts.build:compiler: bun run --cwd packages/reference-postgres build && bun run --cwd packages/data build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/node typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/cli typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/api typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/browser-demo typecheck
scripts.typecheck:compiler: bun run --cwd packages/reference-postgres typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/data typecheck && bun run alpha:release:typecheck
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test packages/core/tests packages/node/tests packages/cli/tests packages/api/tests packages/browser-demo/tests
scripts.test:watch: bun test --watch packages/core/tests packages/node/tests packages/cli/tests packages/api/tests packages/browser-demo/tests
scripts.test:parity: RUN_PARITY_TESTS=true bun test packages/core/tests packages/node/tests packages/cli/tests
scripts.alpha:release:build: bun run --cwd packages/reference-postgres build && bun scripts/browser-alpha-release.ts build
scripts.alpha:release:refresh-lock: bun run --cwd packages/reference-postgres build && bun scripts/browser-alpha-release.ts refresh-lock
scripts.alpha:release:verify: bun run --cwd packages/reference-postgres build && bun scripts/browser-alpha-release.ts verify
scripts.dev: bun run build && concurrently -n core,api -c blue,green "bun run --cwd packages/core build:watch" "tsx --watch --env-file=.env packages/api/src/index.ts"
